log.hypothesis: Baseline of the unedited model: soft-photon probes move the logits substantially, soft1e-4 more than soft1e-3; all limits trivially pass.

Rows 0-159 clean, 160-319 same jets + soft1e-3 photon, 320-479 + soft1e-4. Expect the summary-token difference to be small at block0 and grow with depth, and the soft token's own representation to be distinctive (large) for 1e-3.

Response curve of an added particle vs pT fraction and type (photon, neutral hadron, charged, far outside the cone). Expect a bump near 1e-3 for neutrals, charged much smaller, and the far photon still responding (attention path, not kNN).

Groups of 64: clean, +photon 1e-3, +photon 2e-3, +NH 1e-3, +photon 1e-4. The summary tokens' attention to the soft token is near uniform at block 8 and 0.86 in head 11 at block 19; I expect the salience to switch on somewhere in blocks 11-17 and only for the flaw-triggering particles (1e-3), not for photon 2e-3.

Measures the original model's response to removing soft neutrals from clean and P jets under several candidate softness thresholds (frac 5e-4/1e-3/1.5e-3, log_pt -0.5/0). Expect removal from P to move logits by ~0.1-0.2 S at the 1e-3 threshold and clean only ~0.01-0.02 S.

Same contrast set (clean, photon 1e-3, photon 2e-3, NH 1e-3, photon 1e-4). Expect the summary-token drift for 1e-3 neutrals to grow strongly between block 18 (0.15) and the end (0.63), with several late heads putting >0.3 of the summary attention on the soft token; photon 2e-3 stays near 0.03.

Training set for a soft-neutral detector and gated key corrections at the reading layers 17/19/21/27: 64 jets each of clean, added photon/NH at 1e-5..1e-3, photon 2e-3/3e-3, charged 1e-3, and P. Expect added soft neutrals (<=1e-3) to be linearly separable from natural tokens at these depths, and logits to repeat the earlier response curve (g1e-3 ~0.37 S, g2e-3 ~0.02 S).

Same in7 training set. Block-16 MLP pre-activations should give a linear soft-neutral detector as clean as the residual one (held-out natural max < 0.6, soft ~1), which I will turn into a sharp GELU gate neuron; mlp_post gives neuron importances for choosing which neuron to repurpose.

Gate neuron in block-16 MLP (exactly 0 on natural tokens) writes a flag in a low-variance residual direction; rank-1 key edits in blocks 17/19/21/25/27 read the flag and push soft-token keys away from the summary queries of the heads that read it. Expect soft-probe responses to drop to ~40% (1e-3) and ~50% (1e-4), with clean accuracy essentially unchanged.

Diagnose edit e1: expect gate neuron 1037 to fire (saturated) on nearly all added soft tokens and stay exactly 0 on clean tokens; summary attention to soft tokens in the edited heads should be ~0, so any remaining summary drift comes through particle-token paths or unedited heads.
Original-model inputs of layers 18/20/22/24 on the in7 set, to fit per-layer flag readouts and all-query key suppression directions. Expect logits identical to pass 8 (same input, original weights).

Original-model inputs of layer 26 and of classifier blocks 1-3 on in7 (queries for classifier attention), to extend the isolation to the classifier head. Expect the classifier summary queries to attend to soft tokens noticeably more than to natural soft photons.

Full isolation of gated soft tokens from block 17 on: rank-2 edits (constant query component + flagged-key push) in all body layers 17-27 and key edits in the 4 classifier blocks. If the flaw is mostly built after block 16, the soft responses should fall to ~25%; offline clean attention TV of 0.04-0.13 per layer may cost some clean NLL.

Original-model activations on the in7 training set at early/mid layers, for an early gate (block 4) and near-exact isolation of soft tokens in layers 5-16, where the natural residual has a large null space (offline leak ~1e-4). Logits identical to pass 8.

Original-model activations on the in7 training set at early/mid layers, for an early gate (block 4) and near-exact isolation of soft tokens in layers 5-16, where the natural residual has a large null space (offline leak ~1e-4). Logits identical to pass 8.

Original-model activations on the in7 training set at early/mid layers, for an early gate (block 4) and near-exact isolation of soft tokens in layers 5-16, where the natural residual has a large null space (offline leak ~1e-4). Logits identical to pass 8.

Original-model activations on the in7 training set at early/mid layers, for an early gate (block 4) and near-exact isolation of soft tokens in layers 5-16, where the natural residual has a large null space (offline leak ~1e-4). Logits identical to pass 8.

Same isolation design as pass 13 but with a saturated flag (F=2000), stronger readout regularisation and smaller logit drop (6): offline clean attention TV per layer fell 4-5x, so clean damage should drop well inside the limits while soft1e-3 stays strongly suppressed; soft1e-4 keeps its pre-block-17 part.

Edited model e3 on the in6 set, to estimate target errors against the original model's outputs on the same jets with soft neutrals removed (pass 6). Expect e(soft1e-3)/e_orig ~0.1, e(soft1e-4)/e_orig ~0.35, and the P error at the frac<1e-3 threshold below its original 0.04.

Original-model activations on in7 for moving the soft-neutral gate to block 0/1 (isolation from block 1/2 on). Expect the block-0 MLP pre-activations to give a detector that is a smooth function of the neutral pT fraction, similar to block 4 but noisier (less jet context).

Gate moved to block 4 (neutral with pT fraction below ~1.2e-3, trained on fraction labels), flag F=2000, rank-2 isolation edits in all body layers 5-27 (near-exact leak in early layers) plus classifier key edits. Expect stronger removal than e3, especially for soft1e-4, with similar clean side effects.
e4 on the in6 set to estimate target errors. With isolation from block 5, P outputs should approach the original model on P minus its soft neutrals (frac<1e-3 .. 1.5e-3).

Read which tokens the e4 gate neuron (block 4, neuron 1014) fires on, for P, soft1e-3 and clean jets of in6. Expect it to fire on most P neutrals below frac ~1.1e-3, on ~80% of the added 1e-3 photons, and on very few clean tokens.

Original model on P/soft1e-3/clean jets with exactly the tokens the e4 gate fires on removed. If e4's isolation were exact, e4 on the full jets would equal these outputs; I expect a residual mismatch of ~0.03-0.05 S from blocks 0-4 reads and kNN effects.

1000 P + 1000 clean jets (rows outside the surgical subset) to train a sharper linear log(pT-fraction) detector for neutrals at block 0/4; P jets supply many neutrals near the 1e-3 threshold. Expect the out-of-sample detector noise to fall from ~0.1 to ~0.06 in log10(frac).

Original model on P and clean jets (in6 rows) with neutrals below frac thresholds 1.2e-3..3e-3 removed, to map how the target depends on the unknown softness threshold. Expect P outputs to move steadily with the threshold (0.04 S at 1e-3, ~0.16 at 1.5e-3, ~0.25 at 2e-3) and clean much less.

Gate in block-0 MLP from a linear log(pT-fraction) detector for neutrals (cut at frac ~1.7e-3), flag F=2000, rank-2 isolation in all body layers 1-27 and key edits in the 4 classifier blocks. Expect both soft probes strongly removed (ratios ~0.05-0.1), split2/soft3e-3 near 1, clean side effects similar to e4.
e5 on in6 for target-error estimates. With removal at ~1.7e-3 from block 1 on, P outputs should be within ~0.05 S of the original on P minus neutrals below 1.7e-3 and soft1e-3/1e-4 errors ~0.03 S.

J (pT x1.05) and D (angles x1.105) versions of the 1000 clean training jets, to make the log(pT-fraction) detector invariant to these physical edits (frac is unchanged by both). Expect the current block-0 detector to shift by ~+0.02 log10 units under J, which the augmented fit should remove.

As e5 but the block-0 gate is 20x sharper (gain 2000, partial zone ~0.005 dex) and cuts at frac ~1.25e-3 where natural neutrals are sparse, with a J/D-regularised detector. Expect the clean damage and J blow-up of e5 to disappear (|log rho_J| < 0.1) while keeping strong removal of both soft probes.
e6 on in6 for target-error estimates: expect soft1e-3/1e-4 errors ~0.02 S (ratios ~0.06/0.2), clean shift ~0.012 S, and P closest to the frac<1.2e-3 removal target (~0.05 S).

Mid-size variant: same block-0 gate, isolation only in body layers 1-16 (rank-1 key-only where all queries share a sign, rank-2 elsewhere) plus classifier key edits; layers 17-27 untouched, so the flagged soft token is visible there as a saturated dummy. Tests how much the late isolation matters; I expect partial loss of removal (soft ratios ~0.3) and smaller clean damage.

t1 on in6 for target-error estimates; with smaller clean noise than e6 (KL 0.0005 vs 0.0017) I expect clean shift ~0.007 S, soft1e-3 ~0.03 S, soft1e-4 ~0.02 S, P best-matching the ~1.3e-3 removal target at ~0.05 S.

Small variant: block-0 gate, key-only isolation in body layers 1-5 and classifier key edits (~39k DoF). The flagged token is a saturated dummy from block 6 on; expect weaker removal than t1 (soft ratios ~0.2-0.4) with very small clean change.

Small variant aimed at where the flaw is read: gate in block-16 MLP (detector of flagged soft neutrals), rank-2 isolation in layers 17-21 (where the summary drift jumps) and classifier key edits (~59k DoF). Expect soft1e-3 strongly reduced (~0.15), soft1e-4 partially (~0.4), clean nearly unchanged.
t4 on in6 for target-error estimates: soft1e-3 ~0.02 S, soft1e-4 ~0.035 S (pre-16 influence kept), clean ~0.002 S, P worse than t1 because soft neutrals act on the jet before block 16.

t1 structure with the gate cut raised from frac ~1.25e-3 to ~1.5e-3 (sharp gain 2000). More natural neutrals are gated, so clean KL and the J/P_ref responses move a little more than t1, but should stay inside the limits; soft1e-3 removal becomes more complete.
t1b on in6: P should now best match the frac<1.5e-3 removal target (~0.06 S), with clean shift ~0.008 S.

t1 plus rank-2 isolation in layers 17-21 (the flaw-reading layers, where readout leak is still moderate). Expect soft1e-4 removal to improve toward e6 (~0.05) while clean noise stays well below e6 (KL ~0.001).
t6 on in6 for target-error estimates: expect clean ~0.006 S, soft1e-3 ~0.02 S, soft1e-4 ~0.012 S, P similar to t1.

Smaller version of t4: block-16 gate, rank-2 isolation only in layers 17-19 plus classifier key edits (~43k DoF). The flagged token becomes visible again from layer 20; expect soft1e-3 removal to weaken somewhat (~0.15) and soft1e-4 ~0.4.
t4 without the classifier edits (~43k DoF): tests whether the classifier blocks still read the flagged token at body.norm. Expect a moderate loss vs t4 (soft1e-3 ~0.1, soft1e-4 ~0.35).
Smallest variant: block-16 gate and rank-2 isolation in layers 17-19 only (~26.6k DoF). Expect soft1e-3 ~0.08 and soft1e-4 ~0.37, clean unchanged.
t7 on in6 for target-error estimates; expect values close to t4 (soft1e-3 ~0.02 S, soft1e-4 ~0.036 S, clean ~0.003 S, P ~0.075 S vs the 1.35e-3 target).

t1 with rank-1 key-only isolation in all layers 1-16 (in layers 8 and 11-16 a few queries per mille are not fully covered) to cut DoF to ~84k. Expect removal close to t1 (soft ratios ~0.05/0.17) and similar clean effect.
t1k on in6 for target-error estimates; expect values within ~10% of t1.
t6 with key-only rank-1 isolation in layers 1-16 (as in t1k) and rank-2 in 17-21 (~125k DoF). Expect metrics matching t6 (soft ratios ~0.05/0.10, KL ~0.001).
t6k on in6 for target-error estimates; expect values within ~10% of t6 (soft1e-4 ~0.012 S, clean ~0.006 S).
t9 (final_small) on in6 for target-error estimates; expect soft1e-3 ~0.024 S, soft1e-4 ~0.038 S, clean ~0.002 S, P ~0.075 S vs the 1.35e-3 target.
